## Requirements: trusted Pages E2E proof coverage despite the 100-run mixed-workflow window

**Parent:** #1906 / #1782. Follow-up to #1923 Closed and the independent workflow activation #1930 Closed.

### Real production symptom
At main merge SHA `8a6d579eea2ff580ab00deeab5da6f8d969ca8ba`, public [Pages deployment Run 39141427257](https://github.com/BestNathan/nession/actions/runs/39141427257) succeeded with pinned Acceptance Store, `acceptance_e2e=truncated`, **`published_e2e_ids=0`**. The reader was fed only the first 100 *mixed* repository Actions Runs, which can be saturated by unrelated workflows before a matching `E2E / Tests` or `E2E / Test Ingest` Run appears. The canonical Store contains valid exact-SHA Issue Test/Ingest receipts (e.g., PR #1929 run `39134974690/1` and trusted ingest `39135344379`) but the current mixed window does not suffice to certify them.

### Contract
- Build-time read-only, bounded workflow-specific Actions windows for **both** `e2e-tests.yml` and `e2e-test-ingest.yml`. The browser receives neither GitHub token nor raw response. Fail closed to `unavailable` when either independent workflow window cannot be loaded, never silently publish 0 as an independently verified source.
- Preserve full independent Run/Attempt identity for both sets (up to 100 per workflow), exact trusted workflow paths, repository/origin and completed-success state. Protect against duplicate IDs, ambiguity and 100-result truncation. Data still only qualifies if it is independently verified against the canonical pinned Issue E2E Run and Test Ingest receipt with same plan/artifact digest and matching current PR HEAD.
- Unit test mixed-window starvation, replay, duplicate, missing/failing source, old/foreign paths, stale HEAD and the 100+100 boundary. Keep existing Pages standalone and mobile E2E; no new writer, claim of SC Pass or incorrect PR/Agent lineage attribution. A legitimately missing current PR HEAD still remains no observed proof.

### Success Criteria
- [x] SC-01 Source build uses independently bounded E2E Tests + Test Ingest workflow-specific queries; a missing/rejected source fails closed and dedupe/order are deterministic.
- [x] SC-02 Canonical pinned per-ID reader uses the complete bounded two-workflow Run identities and cannot lose Ingest provenance at a mixed 100-run cutoff, reject mismatch/ambiguous/foreign/stale records.
- [x] SC-03 Negative/unit regression and exact-head Pages CI, Quality Gate, Case Smoke, selected E2E plus read-only Agent evaluation Pass. Full Acceptance workflow success remains external merge gate.
- [ ] SC-04 Post-merge real standalone Pages build correctly handles both `push` and `pull_request` E2E Tests workflow events without promoting main push to PR-head proof. Public HTTPS JSON passes exact merge SHA/digest deployment checks and reports canonical E2E source `available` or `truncated` (not `unavailable` due legitimate push events), with honest per-ID matched count. Trusted post-merge Agent verification, not a manually asserted Pass.

## Acceptance Plan
```yaml
acceptance:
  SC-01:
    when: pr
    method: agent
  SC-02:
    when: pr
    method: agent
  SC-03:
    when: pr
    method: agent
  SC-04:
    when: merged
    branch: main
    method: agent
```
